title: Risk overlay: destructive or irreversible operations
description: Operations that destroy data or cannot be cleanly undone (force push, hard reset, permanent delete, dropping a table).

rules.title: Explicit confirmation before any irreversible action
rules.purpose: Prevent unrecoverable loss from a single unconfirmed step.
rules.requirement: Each irreversible action must be named explicitly to the user, along with what would be lost, and confirmed before it runs -- a prior approval for a similar action does not carry forward.
rules.evidence_requirement: A transcript entry showing the specific irreversible action was confirmed immediately before it ran.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 13: destructive filesystem/repo actions; general safety rules on hard-to-reverse operations.

rules.title: Prefer a reversible alternative when one exists
rules.purpose: Reduce how often irreversible confirmation is even needed.
rules.requirement: Where a reversible action achieves the same goal (move instead of delete, stash instead of reset --hard), it is used instead unless the user explicitly asked for the irreversible form.
rules.evidence_requirement: The action log shows a reversible path was considered.
rules.source_or_rationale: General safety rules: 'prefer a reversible step over deleting'.
